candidates.title: Accelerating the Mitigation of LLM Inference Nondeterminism Across GPU Architectures
candidates.reason: Cross-GPU reproducible LLM inference is implemented with fixed-configuration fused-upcast GEMM kernels and reports 1.17–3.1x end-to-end speedups over the prior deterministic approach, making it directly relevant to inference kernels and runtime reproducibility.

candidates.title: Beyond Scalar Sensitivity: Activation-Aware Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization with Cross-Layer Refinement
candidates.reason: CASA directly addresses mixed-precision bit allocation for LLM deployment, replacing scalar sensitivity with activation-aware Hessian structure and cross-layer refinement, especially for sub-3-bit inference.

candidates.title: Accelerating Dense LLMs via L0-regularized Mixture-of-Experts
candidates.reason: L0-MoE targets inference acceleration by converting dense computation into lightweight sparse expert computation and reports up to 2.5x speedup, aligning with adaptive expert computation and MoE efficiency lineages.

candidates.title: Understanding LLM Quantization through Activation-Guided Compensation and Orthogonal Residuals
candidates.reason: The work provides a deployment-relevant decomposition for aggressive W4A4 post-training quantization and derives practical rotation/scaling guidance validated across eight Llama and Mistral models.

candidates.title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization
candidates.reason: This paper studies whether sink-aware inference policies remain valid after 4-bit PTQ and includes Jetson Orin NX measurements, providing concrete deployment guidance for quantized attention/KV-management policies.
